title: Aromatic Authentic Northern Thai Chicken Kao Mun Gai
description: This traditional Northern Thai dish features chicken cooked in unsweetened coconut milk, served with steamed rice and various toppings, creating a salty and nostalgic experience.
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat and cook the curry paste until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides.
Pour in the coconut milk and add the fish sauce, lime juice, palm sugar, salt, and pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Prepare steamed rice according to package instructions.
Slice the cooked chicken into thin strips.
Assemble the dish by placing the chicken on top of the steamed rice and garnishing with chopped Thai basil leaves.
Offer various toppings such as sliced chilies, diced cucumbers, and pickled ginger on the side.
Encourage guests to customize their own bowls.
